entries.sense_en: lasting only a very short time; quickly vanishing

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for something that passes almost as soon as it appears.
Literary; often for beautiful things (flowers, fame) that last a very short time.
Formal; describes states or conditions that are not meant to last.

entries.sense_en: a person who stays in a place only a short time and then moves on

synonyms.nuance: Someone with no fixed home or job who moves from place to place; slightly negative.
More negative and legal in tone: a homeless person without work.
Someone who rents a room in another person's house; says nothing about how long they stay.
synonyms.example: a lodger in the back room

entries.sense_en: the place where someone lives; a home

synonyms.nuance: Formal or literary word for a building where people live.
Formal, official; used in addresses and legal writing.
The ordinary, warm word; suggests belonging, which an abode need not.

entries.sense_en: to move quickly and lightly from one place to another

synonyms.nuance: Quick, light flapping movement, like wings; less about changing places.
A sudden, fast move in one direction.
synonyms.example: a mouse darted across the floor

synonyms.nuance: Slow and aimless, without effort or purpose; flit is quicker.

entries.sense_en: coming after and left behind by something or someone

synonyms.nuance: Neutral: simply after in time or order.
Stresses the results of a disaster or big event.
synonyms.example: in the aftermath of the war

synonyms.nuance: Physical position only; does not suggest something left behind as a result.

entries.tip_ko: 배가 지나간 뒤의 물결(wake)에서 나온 표현입니다.

entries.sense_en: to move around quietly and slowly, as if searching for something

synonyms.nuance: Aimless and relaxed, with no sense of hunting or threat.
Stay hidden and waiting, usually for a bad purpose; prowl keeps moving.
Move freely over a wide area; no sense of stealth.

entries.sense_en: having eaten or had far more than enough

synonyms.nuance: Informal: too full of food.
Literary: fully satisfied, sometimes to the point of no longer wanting more.
Stronger and greedier: filled by eating too much too fast.

entries.sense_en: available to be rented from the owner

synonyms.nuance: The usual American phrase on signs and ads.
Says only that nobody lives there, not that it is offered for rent.
General: can be used or taken now; needs context to mean renting.

entries.modern: "a room to let" → "a room for rent"
entries.tip_ko: 영국식 표현이며 미국에서는 "for rent"를 주로 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: made less strong or severe

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word: make less harsh.
Formal; used for pain, suffering or poverty.
Plain and general: make smaller in amount, with no sense of easing a bad thing.

entries.tip_ko: "militate(작용하다)"와 혼동하지 마세요.

entries.sense_en: thick and sticky, like glue or slime

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for anything that clings to the touch.
Wet, slippery and unpleasant, like mud or a slug.
Thick and adhesive like glue; less disgusting than viscid or slimy.

entries.sense_en: smelling very bad and unhealthy, as if full of rotting growth

synonyms.nuance: General: very unpleasant to smell or taste.
Specific to fats and food that have gone bad.
Old and not fresh, but not necessarily disgusting; rank is stronger.

entries.tip_ko: "계급, 순위"의 rank와는 다른 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: a small hollow place in a wall where a statue or vase can stand

synonyms.nuance: A larger recess in a room, big enough for a bed or seat.
General word for any part set back into a wall.
A small, cozy corner; suggests comfort rather than decoration.

entries.tip_ko: "니치" 또는 "니슈"로 발음합니다.

entries.sense_en: would have refused to admit as its own; would have disowned

synonyms.nuance: Formal: give up a belief, claim or habit publicly.
Refuse to accept as one's own, especially a person or product.
Plain everyday phrase; no sense of a solemn promise.

entries.modern: "would have forsworn" → "would have refused to own"

entries.sense_en: arranged to have and use (a room) by agreeing to pay for it

synonyms.nuance: Everyday: reserve in advance a room, ticket or table.
Pay regularly to use, usually for longer periods.
Keep for later use; you may not yet have moved in.

entries.tip_ko: "약혼한"이나 "바쁜" 뜻으로만 알기 쉽습니다.

entries.sense_en: remember someone or something

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for having something in memory.
More formal; suggests making an effort to bring something back.
Also describes a thing that makes you think of another.
synonyms.example: it brings to mind old days

entries.sense_en: going on and on without stopping

synonyms.nuance: Everyday: seems to have no end, often tiresome.
Stays the same or happens all the time; neutral in tone.
Continuing without pause, and annoying.

entries.sense_en: soft wet sand that pulls down anything that steps on it
entries.sense_ko: 유사(流沙), 빠져들면 헤어나기 어려운 늪

synonyms.nuance: A large area of wet, muddy land with plants; not sand and not sucking in.
Wet, spongy ground of peat that holds feet; slow, not sudden.
Deep mud; also used figuratively for a bad situation you cannot escape.

entries.sense_en: soft, wet mud at the bottom of water

synonyms.nuance: Ordinary wet earth.
Slippery, sticky and unpleasant substance.
Thick, dirty, half-liquid waste.

entries.tip_ko: 동사로 "스며 나오다"의 뜻도 흔합니다.

entries.sense_en: looking good or right on the surface but actually false

synonyms.nuance: General: gives a wrong idea, whether on purpose or not.
Seems believable; unlike specious, it may turn out to be true.
Without real substance or sincerity.

entries.sense_en: done as a duty, without real interest or care

synonyms.nuance: Done without enthusiasm, but some effort is made.
Quick and not thorough, usually about looking or checking.
Done automatically, like a machine, without feeling.

entries.sense_en: looking tired, thin and worn out

synonyms.nuance: Very thin with hollow cheeks, from illness or hunger.
Face tight and tired-looking because of worry or pain.
Describes how one feels, not only how one looks.

entries.sense_en: the soft cloth covering on a couch or chair

synonyms.nuance: General word for anything that covers.
The soft stuffing inside, not the outer cloth.
Cloth in general, not only for furniture.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절 -hol-에 있습니다: [ʌpˈhoʊl-].

entries.sense_en: not moving, as if without energy

synonyms.nuance: Simply not moving; says nothing about energy or feeling.
Soft and lifeless, like a body with no strength.
Slow and lazy in moving, but still moving.

entries.sense_en: several and different; various

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word for several different kinds.
Just more than two; does not say the items differ.
Mixed together as a selection, like chocolates.

entries.tip_ko: "잠수부(divers)"와 철자가 같지만 여기서는 "여러 가지의"라는 옛 형용사입니다.

entries.sense_en: leaned back or lay back in a relaxed position

synonyms.nuance: Plain phrase; body tilts back but need not be relaxed.
Sit or lie lazily and comfortably.
Sit or lie with limbs spread out in an untidy way.

entries.sense_en: small things left behind, like wreckage floating on the sea

synonyms.nuance: Broken pieces left after something is destroyed.
Worthless things, informal.
Remains of something crashed or smashed, like a ship or plane.

entries.sense_en: not straight; pulled or hanging to one side

synonyms.nuance: Bent or not straight; can describe a shape as well as position.
Uneven, one side higher or heavier than the other.
Literary; also means "gone wrong", as in plans going awry.

entries.sense_en: people left stranded in a place they cannot easily leave
entries.sense_ko: 고립된 사람들, 오도 가도 못한 이들

synonyms.nuance: Stuck somewhere without a way to move on, often by accident.
Deliberately left by others; no mention of being cut off.
Far from others; may be the person's choice.

entries.tip_ko: the marooned처럼 형용사가 명사로 쓰여 "고립된 사람들"을 뜻합니다. 뒤의 sail, port와 함께 난파 비유를 이룹니다.

entries.sense_en: worn so thin that the threads show

synonyms.nuance: General: damaged by long use.
Looks poor and untidy from age and hard use; can describe a person.
Torn and uneven at the edges; worse than threadbare.

entries.sense_en: too bright and colorful in an ugly way

synonyms.nuance: Bright and showy in a cheap way, often about decorations.
Designed to be noticed, sometimes expensive; less negative.
Informal: cheap and in bad taste.

entries.sense_en: patient self-control when angry or provoked

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for calmly waiting or putting up with trouble.
Holding oneself back from acting or speaking.
Accepting what you dislike in others; about attitude, not self-control.

entries.sense_en: caused (damage or anger) to fall on something

synonyms.nuance: Cause pain or harm to someone; the object is often a person.
Set free something strong and violent.
Plain word; without force or violence.

entries.tip_ko: "wreak havoc(큰 피해를 입히다)"로 자주 쓰입니다. wreck과 혼동 주의.

entries.sense_en: split or cut through with force

synonyms.nuance: Everyday: break into parts along a line.
Cut with quick blows of an axe or knife.
Cut something completely off.

entries.tip_ko: cleave는 "쪼개다"와 "달라붙다" 두 반대 뜻이 있어 헷갈립니다.

entries.sense_en: written in a quick, messy way

synonyms.nuance: Write or draw quickly and carelessly; can be a child's marks.
Cut lines into a surface with something sharp.
synonyms.example: scratch a name into the wall

synonyms.nuance: Write briefly and quickly; neat is fine.

entries.sense_en: unpleasantly damp and cold

synonyms.nuance: Slightly wet; can be neutral.
Damp and sticky, especially about skin.
Smelling of old, closed-up damp places.

entries.sense_en: an unpleasant smell or gas given off by something

synonyms.nuance: A very strong, disgusting smell.
Smoke or gas that can be harmful.
Literary: an unhealthy vapor hanging in the air.
synonyms.example: a miasma rising from the swamp

entries.sense_en: starting and stopping at irregular times

synonyms.nuance: Informal spoken phrase for the same idea.
Now and then; says nothing about a pattern of stopping and starting.
Scattered and irregular; suggests unpredictability.

entries.sense_en: a sudden strong push of wind

synonyms.nuance: A short, sudden rush of wind.
A strong, violent rush of air or heat.
A hit; in the wind sense, less common than gust.

entries.tip_ko: 뷔페(buffet /bəˈfeɪ/)와 발음과 뜻이 다른 단어입니다.

entries.sense_en: in a way that allows no refusal; urgently and commandingly

synonyms.nuance: Formal: as if a command that must be obeyed.
With need for immediate action; no sense of ordering.
Informal and negative: in an annoying, controlling way.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절 -remp-에 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: mixed together so they could not be told apart

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for putting things together.
Mix so smoothly that the parts become one.
Join into one, often two streams or groups.

entries.sense_en: to pull or get something away with effort

synonyms.nuance: Grab quickly and suddenly.
Draw out with effort or skill, often information.
Pull with a hard twist.

entries.tip_ko: "wrestle(레슬링하다)"과 발음이 비슷하지만 다른 단어입니다. w는 소리 나지 않습니다.

entries.sense_en: searching every part of a place roughly and leaving it a mess

synonyms.nuance: Neutral: look carefully for something.
Look through things by pushing them around, less violent.
Steal from a place during a riot or war.

entries.sense_en: thrown away because no longer wanted

synonyms.nuance: Left behind, often on purpose and for good.
Thrown away, especially clothes, after use.
Not wanted; does not say whether it was thrown out.

entries.tip_ko: 명사 discard(버린 패)는 강세가 첫 음절에 옵니다: [ˈdɪskɑːrd].

entries.sense_en: gives away no information or secrets
entries.sense_ko: 아무것도 말해 주지 않다, 비밀을 누설하지 않다

synonyms.nuance: Plain phrase; deliberately not telling.
Simply not speak about something.
In the positive form, means to report on someone to get them in trouble.

entries.tip_ko: "Dead men tell no tales"로 유명한 표현입니다.

entries.sense_en: quiet, modest and not attracting attention

synonyms.nuance: Not showing off; can apply to anyone or anything.
Nervous around other people; demure is calm and proper.
Too proper and easily shocked; more negative.

entries.sense_en: following the smell of something, or close to finding it

synonyms.nuance: Following clues or tracks to find someone or something.
synonyms.example: detectives on the trail of a thief

synonyms.nuance: Close behind someone, chasing.
Following marks or signs step by step.

entries.sense_en: walked across or through

synonyms.nuance: Everyday: go from one side to the other.
Travel a distance.
Walk back and forth, often nervously.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절 -verse에 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: searching by moving things around carelessly

synonyms.nuance: Search deep into a pile or bag.
Informal: feel about clumsily, like an animal.
Search for a specific thing; may not involve messing things up.

entries.sense_en: in a way that touches the heart with sadness

synonyms.nuance: Stirring emotion; can be happy or sad.
Gently emotional, often about kindness or innocence.
Emotionally hurting; harsher and less tender than poignantly.

entries.tip_ko: [ˈpɔɪnjənt]로 g는 발음하지 않습니다.

entries.sense_en: moved around searching with his hands, unable to see clearly

synonyms.nuance: Search or handle clumsily, often with nervous hands.
Plain word: search by touch.
Struggle without direction, physically or mentally.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 영어에서 "grope"는 성적으로 더듬는다는 뜻으로도 쓰이니 주의하세요.

entries.sense_en: pushed and dug his way into small hidden places

synonyms.nuance: Plain word: make a hole with hands or a tool.
Search deep into something, often papers or a subject.
Make a long passage under the ground.

entries.sense_en: sharp and forceful in expression

synonyms.nuance: Sharp and hurtful, especially about remarks and wind.
Clear, sharp and intelligent, usually positive.
Rough and severe; lacks the sense of clever sharpness.

entries.sense_en: moving from place to place; never staying long

synonyms.nuance: Living a wandering life as a way of life, like a tribe.
Travelling from place to place for work.
Wandering around freely, often with no set goal.

entries.sense_en: asked in an eager and pleading way

synonyms.nuance: Everyday: ask desperately, often for something you need.
Formal and very emotional.
Ask with strong emotion, often to avoid a punishment.

entries.tip_ko: beseech의 과거형은 besought이며 [bɪˈsɔːt]로 읽습니다.

entries.sense_en: gave life and energy to

synonyms.nuance: Make more lively or interesting.
Give life or movement, often to drawings or objects.
Bring back to life or strength after weakness.

entries.sense_en: to meet and gather together

synonyms.nuance: Everyday: come together in one place.
More formal or organized gathering.
Gather in a crowd, often for a shared purpose.

entries.sense_en: prepare a dead body for burial

synonyms.nuance: General: get something ready.
Put things in order; nothing about death.
The common meaning: put things flat so that all can be seen.

entries.tip_ko: "lay out"은 보통 "펼치다, 배치하다"의 뜻으로 쓰이지만 여기서는 염하는 일을 뜻합니다.
